pages.text:
Insulated gear made from Rock Wool, Slag Wool and Steel Plates. It armors like leather.
- Each piece cuts fire and hot-block damage by 25%.
# Full suit
- Immune to fire and burning, and safe on magma.
- **Lava shield**: 8 seconds of protection in lava. A bar over your hotbar counts it down; once you leave the lava it recharges after 60 seconds.
